purpose: Replace the Philosopher's Path themed globe with a recognizable mapped Higashiyama street diorama
authorization: Current user asks to recreate Ninenzaka/Sannenzaka and replace the current Kyoto scene; existing session authorizes native Blender assets, Three.js integration, and publication.

sources.use: Road coordinates, staircase counts, nearby building anchors and Yasaka pagoda location
Visual reference: stone stairs, close wooden shopfronts, tile eaves, lattice windows, Yasaka pagoda. Reference photos are not redistributed in the site.

coordinateTransform.elevation: Authored continuous profile, not surveyed terrain

hero: Stone stair streets with continuous machiya frontages; Yasaka pagoda at its mapped anchor
symmetry: None: preserve real street topology rather than radial or rectangular repetition
circulation: Mapped paths and connected shop aprons. Only doors with adequate clear width and unobstructed aprons admit NPCs.
openings: Six native Exact Boolean openings across two reusable facade assets; storefronts have shop floors and internal counters behind the openings.
camera: Orbit overview, three street viewpoints, NPC follow and user-controlled third-person exploration; opaque geometry ray collision and near-player fade.
input: WASD / arrow keys move in camera-relative directions
Drag camera, wheel changes follow distance
Nearby left-click / E opens or closes shop door
C toggles exploration; Escape returns to overview
Preserved NPC follow/change visitor, pause and automatic overview orbit
readiness: Map, native architecture GLB, resident GLB, lighting, controls and animation initialized before loading overlay disappears
reviewPolicy: Historical human approvals retained unchanged. This addendum does not invent new human Form or browser approval.
knownVerificationLimit: No compatible browser preview tool in this session; Node simulation and offline Blender composition renders are not a browser/WebGL pass. The generic room validator retains unmet Meshy, browser, texture-tier, lightmap and performance fields; no passing gate claim is made.

player.nativeAsset: Resident from town-assets.glb, independently cloned with amber jacket
player.collision: Pavement and connected aprons, authored shop interiors, solid facades and native aperture dimensions, dynamic door leaf, counters, shelves, planters, benches and parking envelope
player.doorSafety: Hold open while player occupies doorway; NPC passage remains allowed
player.modePersistence: Position retained when switching views; not persisted across page reload
player.readiness: Player, movement surface, input listeners and HUD initialized before loading overlay disappears
